node.title: Re: Password with special characters (updated)
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
I wrote about this topic at length [id://1180578|here]. In this case, assuming this is on Windows, you might want to just use [mod://Win32::ShellQuote], e.g. its quote_system_list - but make sure to read the module's documentation in any case.

Update: For example, system(quote_system_list('NET','USE','g:','\\\\\\',$pw,'/user:'))==0 or die "system failed, \$?=$?";
